children: The Avalanche Foundation has awarded grants of up to $50,000 each to six research projects, according to Crowdfund Insider. According to Foresight News, recipients include Stanford University, the University of Oxford, Imperial College London, Nanyang Technological University, the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), and the University of Saskatchewan. The projects examine topics including value accrual in Layer 1 ecosystems, the effect of staking on token valuation, and the macroeconomics of decentralization in proof-of-stake networks. Their findings will help guide the development of the Avalanche network.

title: Avalanche Foundation Awards Up to $50,000 Each to Six Blockchain Economics Research Projects
